title: When the Well Wakes
author: S. M. Underhill
blurb: Petra Nystrom, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
